record.question: Consider the following statements regarding the new railway line in Mizoram: (i) It connects Bairabi with Sairang. (ii) The total length of the new railway line is 101 kms. (iii) The project is divided into four sections – Bairabi-Hortoki, Hortoki-Kawnpui, Kawnpui-Mualkhang, and Mualkhang-Sairang. (iv) The Commission of Railway Safety (CRS) has recently approved the opening of the railway line from Hortoki to Sairang in Mizoram. Which of the above statements are correct?
